import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Distribution of dog ages
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax1.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_xlabel('Dog Age', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dogs by district (Kreis)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
kreis_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(kreis_counts)))
ax2.barh(range(len(kreis_counts)), kreis_counts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(kreis_counts)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(kreis_counts.index)
ax2.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Dogs by District (Kreis)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Top dog breeds
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
ax3.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax3.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Top Dog Breeds (Primary)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
ax3.invert_yaxis()

# 4. Timeline of registrations by year
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
yearly_counts = df.groupby('StichtagDatJahr')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_index()
ax4.plot(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='darkgreen', markerfacecolor='lightgreen', 
         markeredgecolor='darkgreen', markeredgewidth=2)
ax4.fill_between(yearly_counts.index, yearly_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='lightgreen')
ax4.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_xticks(yearly_counts.index)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
